summary: Returns the raw Windows handle for a CRT file descriptor entry. Guards the descriptor index against the open file count (uNumber), locates the entry as dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F) (a block table with 32 entries per 36-byte stride), and returns the handle dword at the entry base when the open flag (bit 0 of the byte at entry + 4) is set. On an out-of-range index or a closed entry it writes TLS error 9 via TLSOffsetGetter and clears the extended error slot via TLSOffsetGetter_afd8, then returns -1.

local_names.dword_8D4920: pointer table base for CRT file entries (36-byte entry stride)
local_names.uNumber: open file count used as the index upper bound

operations.description: Descriptor index a1 is validated against the open file count uNumber; the table lookup only runs while a1 < uNumber
Entry address = dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F): a1 selects one of the pointer slots (a1 >> 5), then an entry within a 32-entry block at 36-byte stride (a1 & 0x1F)
Open-flag test: the byte at entry + 4 must have bit 0 set; when set the function returns the handle dword stored at the entry base
Failure path writes TLS error code 9 through the TLSOffsetGetter pointer and clears the extended error slot through TLSOffsetGetter_afd8 (literal 0)

Returns the entry handle dword on success, or -1 on an out-of-range index or closed entry; called by HandleCloseWithErrorReporting (0058C38E), FileSeekViaSetFilePointer (0058C789), sub_592891 (00592891), FilePointerSeekWithErrorHandling (00595F82), sub_59797B (0059797B) and sub_59B650 (0059B650)

unresolved: The 36-byte entry layout (handle dword at offset 0, flags byte at offset 4) is inferred from the raw accesses only; the full CRT file-entry structure is not defined in this packet
The meaning of the extended error slot written via TLSOffsetGetter_afd8 is not documented beyond the literal 0
